xln.text: Ixalan is where Azor sacrifices his spark to create the Immortal Sun, trapping himself there and preventing planeswalkers from leaving the plane.
Long afterward, Vraska poses as a pirate on the high seas while Jace is stranded on the plane without his memories, and her crew fishes him out of the sea and she spares him.
The Legion of Dusk, the Brazen Coalition, Kumena, Huatli, Angrath and Vraska all race to Orazca for the Immortal Sun, while the Sun Empire and River Heralds also seek the city's secret.
Jace's memories partly return after he falls into the Golden City's waters, and he and Vraska are swept off their ship as it runs onto the rocks near the island.

rix.text: Ixalan's golden city of Orazca finally rises from the valley, and Huatli and Angrath watch its spires climb above the canopy; the city looks nothing like the one Huatli saw in her vision.
Angrath shows Huatli that they are locked on the plane, and near Orazca they meet Saint Elenda, who says the city has awoken at last and vows to teach the Legion of Dusk what they forgot.
Huatli leaves Angrath pinned under her dinosaur to keep her earlier deal with Tishana, and Tishana declares Orazca found and Ixalan at peace.
Vraska summons Tezzeret, who spirits the Immortal Sun off the plane, and Vraska planeswalks away as the portal closes.

lci.text: A year after March of the Machine, groups scramble toward Ixalan's center in search of cosmium, and past the caves the plane is found to be a hollow world with a Core lit by Chimil.
The explorers meet mycoid infestation and fungal titans in the caverns, and River Heralds capture the Legion in the water, while a ghost warns that the door must be closed against the mycoids.

The Core's own history is revealed: the Coin Empire caged the god Chimil, who destroyed her prison after 320 years of darkness, and a fungal outbreak at Topizielo spread through the caverns and gave rise to the mycoids, so the Core was sealed.
Kellan and Amalia side with the Oltec against Aclazotz and help defeat the god and his vampire minions, though Aclazotz escapes on a ship toward Torrezon.
